operations.title: Set original connection synchronous policy
operations.notes: Original-session task transport: sqlite_connection_settings; request.operation=set_connection_synchronous, plus owner-bound session_id. Not a generic independent visual-admin operation. Scope main on the original connection only; no file persistence or future defaults.

operations.title: Set original connection value and row byte limit

fields.label: Confirm this original connection limit change

operations.notes: Original-session task transport: sqlite_connection_limits. Inspect/review with request.limit=length; apply with request.operation=set_connection_limit, request.limit=length and these fields. Owner-bound session_id and database_target_id stay in the envelope. Requires execute; review/apply require administer. Interpreter getlimit/setlimit and SQLITE_LIMIT_LENGTH required; no SQL fallback. Native hard caps may clamp values; display effective_value/outcome, never claim the request was met without read-back. Limit state is not transactional, not file-persisted, and does not change future connections. No automatic retry.
